title: Toilet Paper Holder With Glass Shelf (Covered, Wall Mount) | Glass Shelves Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep toilet tissue protected and everyday essentials within reach with a wall-mounted toilet paper holder that adds a convenient glass shelf above the roll.

  • Instant storage where you need it — integrated glass shelf holds small bathroom items above the tissue holder.
  • Cleaner, more protected rolls — covered toilet paper holder design shields tissue from moisture and dust.
  • Finished look on the wall — concealed screw mounting hardware keeps installation clean and streamlined.
  • Space-saving bathroom organization — wall-mount design keeps surfaces and floor area clear.
  • Coordinate the room — part of the Glass Shelves collection for a cohesive set of transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.

Specs & Installation

  • Dimensions (L x H x W): 8.75 x 4.6 x 6 in.
  • Material: solid brass hardware with glass shelf
  • Mounting: wall mounted; concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Finish options: multiple designer finish options available (28 finishes)
  • Warranty: limited lifetime warranty
  • Box dimensions: 18 x 12 x 6 in.
  • Shipping weight: 7 lbs
